title: Initialization Request Contract
purpose: Defines the atomic JSON initialization request for the bounded local initialization workflow.

normative_requirements.text: An initialization request shall be one JSON object that explicitly supplies a product identifier, an absent or empty destination path, a local source repository path, an exact source revision identifier, and product-direction material.

The product identifier, destination path, local source repository path, exact source revision identifier, and product-direction material shall be required; the request shall be rejected when any required field is missing, empty, structurally invalid, or contradictory.
The initialization request representation shall be JSON and shall not infer omitted authority-bearing values from environment state, repository configuration, remote services, or named references.
